acceptance: Notuning Databricks runs set no autoOptimize properties unless recorded as harness settings in both arms (unit test).
Template auto_optimize/auto_compact keys control the properties.
Liquid AUTO templates carry no unused column lists or document them.
context: Found 2026-10-13 by an adversarial review of Databricks tuning at origin/develop 77048bfb9.
description:
## Problem
- **Baselines are not untuned.** The Databricks adapter ignores the templates' `auto_optimize_enabled`/`auto_compact_enabled`. It uses its own options, which default to True (`benchbox/platforms/databricks/adapter.py:299-304`), so notuning baselines also get autoOptimize TBLPROPERTIES. That is tuning applied to the untuned arm.
- **Liquid AUTO templates list unused columns.** They list 5–6 clustering columns per table, which `CLUSTER BY AUTO` ignores, and the validator would reject more than 4 if the strategy switched to manual liquid.

## Change
- Make notuning baselines run with no autoOptimize properties, or record them as harness settings applied in both arms.
- Drive the properties from the template keys.
- Trim the liquid AUTO templates or document why they list extra columns.
- Coordinate with `spark-baseline-no-default-overrides`.
